description: The extracted text of one document, in windows of up to 40,000 characters (default 20,000). Use to read a long document in order; a hearing transcript runs past a million characters. Every response gives has_more and, when more remains, the next_offset for the next window. Runs of blank lines are shortened to one. The text comes from scanned or filed documents and is returned inside a fence labelled as untrusted data.

lf_id.description: Archive id from a search result, LF- followed by 12 characters, e.g. LF-6e02fd648a12.

offset.description: A byte position: the next_offset value from the previous response. Omit for the beginning.

name: get_document_text
title: Read a record's text
